basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Call of Duty Zombies enthusiast based in Manchester, UK. I work as a software developer by day and spend my nights diving into the intricate world of Zombies Easter eggs. I love helping others in the gaming community, especially on COD Zombies. I’m not big on social media outside of Reddit and I enjoy attending comic cons when I can. Single and enjoying it, I often game late into the night, typically active from 7 PM to 2 AM GMT.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught gamer with a deep understanding of game mechanics, particularly in the Call of Duty franchise. I've been playing COD since World at War and have honed my skills through countless hours of gameplay, online resources, and community interactions.
